faq.q: How do I install Stardew Valley on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Stardew Valley and check the developer is ConcernedApe before tapping the price button. It needs Android 5.0 or newer. It costs $4.99 on Google Play, and once bought it's tied to your Google account, so you can reinstall it on any phone for free. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from ConcernedApe and may be altered, so the safest way to play Stardew Valley is the official listing.

faq.q: How much does Stardew Valley cost on Android?
faq.a: Stardew Valley costs $4.99 on Google Play in the US, as a one-time purchase. It has no ads and no in-app purchases, and updates are free.

faq.q: Does the mobile version have the 1.6 update?
faq.a: Yes. Stardew Valley's big 1.6 update came to mobile, with new content such as a new farm type, festivals and items. The latest Play release fixes bugs in the 1.6 update.

faq.q: Can I play Stardew Valley multiplayer on Android?
faq.a: The mobile version is single-player. Co-op multiplayer is available on PC, Mac, Linux and consoles, but not on Android.

faq.q: Can I move my save from PC to Android?
faq.a: Yes, it's possible by copying save files between devices, though it's a manual process. The game's official wiki explains where save files are stored on each platform.
